item.title: UK consumer confidence hits two-year high in August
item.summary: UK consumer confidence rose to its highest level in two years in August, according to GfK, as optimism about personal finances and the wider economy continued to recover. GfK’s long-running confidence index climbed three points to -14, its best reading in two years and a marked improvement on the -25 recorded as recently as April.
